hypothesis: Two separable increments may improve the Stage1 action layer without touching the frozen base allocator: (1) a coherent single-provider price panel for 2019+ (real 15-minute open / 10:30 close / next open) so the label and replay share one price source; (2) an action training/selection book whose own state, features, label fees and next-reset fees match the cost book being evaluated. Neither increment is assumed to explain the original failure or to raise return.

increment_1_price_consistency.description: Rebuild the 2019+ replay and first-hour features from ONE existing 15-minute Qlib provider's real open / 10:30 close / next open, so the daily-open label and the first-hour state share a single price source.
increment_1_price_consistency.scope: price sourcing only; frozen model identities and the action route are unchanged
increment_1_price_consistency.fail_closed: missing 15-minute bars block; no scaling, no backfill, no interpolation of any price
increment_1_price_consistency.pre_2019: 2016-2018 use the real daily provider with no recovery; a layered native proof is reported separately
increment_1_price_consistency.evidence: daily-open vs 15-minute-first-bar-open comparison already observed: SOXL 3 days > 1bp (2026-04-20 daily 94.68 vs 15m 95.97), SOXX 610 days > 1bp (median 0.136bp, max 6.76bp); recorded, not asserted as the cause of prior results

increment_2_cost_consistent_training.description: Train two independent action books whose own state, features, label fees and next-reset fees match the evaluated cost: a 10bp book with own-state + label10bp, and a 25bp book with own-state + label25bp.
increment_2_cost_consistent_training.scope: one mechanism candidate, two pre-declared fee books; no threshold/feature/beta search
increment_2_cost_consistent_training.outer: 2023+ each book uses the model frozen at 2022-end; outer is reused diagnostic only
increment_2_cost_consistent_training.label_cost: declared explicitly per book and passed into the thin training/settlement wrapper; the sealed source module is not modified and no global label-cost is monkeypatched

separation_rule: Increment 1 (price consistency) and Increment 2 (cost-consistent training) are reported as two separate comparisons. They are never merged into one winning candidate.

references.soxx_buy_hold: SOXX same execution/cost, open-only native reconciled
references.soxx_cash_fixed: pre-declared 50/50 SOXX/cash rebalanced to target and fee-charged; no full-sample fitted matched beta

gates.development_gate: own true no_hold, active, original economic reference and SOXX, all at the candidate's own cost book
gates.promotion: candidate is not_promoted even if it passes history, until independent forward evidence

native_verification.candidate_2019_plus_recovery: required: a real 15-minute intraday native account reconciliation
native_verification.pre_2019: daily native reconciliation only (no intraday bars exist)
native_verification.if_missing: record blocked_native_reconciliation_missing; do not substitute risk_analysis or an open-only path under another name

prerequisites_from_supervisor: reusable native intraday schedule interface (new file)
these do not modify the current diagnosis code
parity_step: Before the candidate, prove the new execution/label wrapper reproduces the original control book end to end (predictions and replay numbers) for execution10/label25; keep that parity result and preserve any candidate failure.
stopping: Exactly one mechanism candidate with two pre-declared fee books against the frozen references; no tuning after outcomes; report all results including failures.
limitations: This plan is not a promotion and does not claim the price discrepancy caused any prior result.
The one-session next-reset cost remains a proxy, not a long-horizon optimization.
Older intraday verification is limited to 2019+ where real bars exist.
